sources.author: EBPatcher
patch_list: Disable only the guarded Java and native debugger detectors; retain authentication and certificate verification.
Disable local USB debugging detection without changing device settings.
Use the original recording controls with an authorized Shizuku recorder; retain failure callbacks and show failure reasons.
Report the scoped Galaxy metadata profile without changing OS, IDs, fingerprint, hardware, product or device.

Use Korean Whisper turbo and Gemma after exact TICKET_ALL_USED or in Always mode. Persist the selected API/local result in the original call-history database, with silent processing notifications and five local histories. Download or updat…
Retain capability, account and permission checks while removing the manufacturer restriction.
Bind an explicit original APK/APKM to this input and preserve original APK and central-directory hashes without bypassing verification.
Remove commercial Google and Kakao banner requests and their reserved space; retain caller information and safety notices.
Deactivate Firebase Analytics and keep AppsFlyer stopped-tracking paths active; preserve Messaging, Crashlytics, authentication and phone services.
